zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the chorus server at {host}:{port}?

announce_origin.message: chorus announces only media that Home Assistant itself serves: the address is not on this Home Assistant's internal or external URL.

announce_origin_not_on_server.message: The chorus server does not announce from this Home Assistant ({origin}). Start chorus-server with --announce-origin {origin}.

announce_volume.message: The announcement volume is a number from 0 to 1.

autoplay_gone.message: The chorus server no longer has an autoplay rule for the input {input}.

browse_unknown.message: There is nothing to browse at {media_id}: chorus offers its inputs and nothing below them.

cannot_connect.message: The chorus server did not answer: {error}

firmware_busy.message: The speaker already has a firmware install in progress: {detail}

firmware_image_not_verified.message: The chorus server did not verify the staged image, or it changed on disk since, so it is not installed. Stage it again and send the server firmware_rescan: {detail}

firmware_nothing_to_install.message: The chorus server has no verified staged image to install on the speaker {speaker}.

firmware_owner_not_at_bench.message: The chorus server installs firmware on a real speaker only while the owner is at the bench (docs/firmware-updates.md names the server setting). Nothing was sent to the speaker: {detail}

group_not_active.message: This saved group is not assembled, so it has no group volume. Turn it on or select a source to assemble it.

join_not_a_room.message: {entity_id} is not a room of this chorus server and cannot join a chorus group.

join_saved_group.message: {entity_id} is a saved group, and a saved group cannot join a room. Join rooms, or turn the saved group on to assemble it.

metrics_unavailable.message: The chorus server's speaker diagnostics could not be read: {error}

refused_command.message: The chorus server refused the command ({field}): {detail}

refused_group.message: The chorus server refused the group: {detail}

refused_image.message: The chorus server refused the firmware image: {detail}

refused_input.message: The chorus server refused the input: {detail}

refused_sound.message: The chorus server refused the sound setting ({field}): {detail}

refused_source.message: The chorus server refused the source: {detail}

refused_speaker.message: The chorus server refused the speaker: {detail}

refused_target.message: The chorus server refused the room or group: {detail}

refused_unavailable.message: The chorus server cannot do that right now: {detail}

refused_url.message: The chorus server refused the announcement's address: {detail}

refused_volume.message: The chorus server refused the volume: {detail}

refused_zone.message: The chorus server refused the room: {detail}

room_gone.message: The chorus server no longer has the room {room}.

unknown_input.message: The chorus server offers no input {input} right now.

unknown_source.message: {source} is not a source this chorus server offers right now.

unsupported_catalog.message: The chorus server does not offer control catalog version 2. Update the server.

unsupported_media.message: chorus plays its inputs (chorus://input/...) and announcements; it cannot play {media_id}.

unsupported_catalog.description: The chorus server of the entry {title} does not offer control catalog version 2, which this integration needs, or is too old to say who it is. Update chorus-server, or install the integration version that matches it, then reload the entry.
